US.description: Includes Federal Income, FICA (Social Security & Medicare), New York State Income, and New York City Income taxes for a single $85k earner.

IN.description: Effective income tax rate includes central government income tax slabs and a 4% health and education cess. Tax rates vary based on income slab and regime chosen (old vs. new).

SG.description: Effective income tax rate includes progressive federal income tax, no capital gains tax.

CH.description: Includes federal, cantonal, municipal income taxes, and social security contributions; varies significantly by canton of residence and municipality.

NL.description: Effective rate for income tax and national insurance contributions for an $85k USD earner.

GB.description: Effective rate includes income tax and National Insurance contributions for an $85k USD equivalent earner.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes, Canada Pension Plan (CPP), and Employment Insurance (EI) contributions for an $85k USD earner in Ontario.

AE.description: No personal income tax for most residents; individuals generally pay 0% on their income.

NO.description: Includes national income tax (with progressive step tax), municipal tax, and social security contributions.

IE.description: Effective tax rate includes income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for a single earner.

LU.description: Effective rate includes national income tax (progressive), social security contributions (health, pension, long-term care), and dependency insurance.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy for an $85k USD (~$127.5k AUD) earner.

QA.description: No personal income tax on salaries and wages for residents.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam has no personal income tax.

MO.description: Macao's professional tax is highly progressive with a substantial tax-free allowance and low top rates, resulting in a very low effective income tax. No sales tax or VAT.
